stakeholders.name: SEAI — Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland
stakeholders.role: National energy agency; runs the main home-energy grant schemes

stakeholders.name: Department of Climate, Energy and the Environment
Local Authorities
stakeholders.role: Promote retrofit schemes and social-housing upgrades

stakeholders.name: Registered One-Stop Shops (service providers)
stakeholders.role: Deliver deep-retrofit projects: management, grant admin, quality assurance

stakeholders.name: Community Groups and Sustainable Energy Communities (SECs)

traditional.name: SEAI Individual Energy Upgrade Grants
traditional.note: Per-measure grants: attic insulation, wall insulation, heat pumps, solar PV, heating controls, windows and doors where eligible.

traditional.name: National Home Energy Upgrade Scheme
traditional.provider: SEAI, delivered through registered One-Stop Shops (service providers)
traditional.note: Grants for deep retrofit to a minimum BER B rating; project management and grant administration handled by the service provider.

traditional.name: Warmer Homes Scheme
traditional.note: Free energy upgrades for eligible low-income households.

traditional.name: SEAI Community Energy Grants
traditional.note: Supports community buildings, homes and businesses through community-led retrofit projects.

traditional.name: Local Authority Supports
traditional.note: Promotion of retrofit schemes and SECs; some social-housing retrofit via national funding streams.

testedGrowing.name: Home Energy Upgrade Loan Scheme
testedGrowing.provider: Government-backed, offered through participating banks and credit unions
testedGrowing.note: Low-cost loans, combinable with SEAI grants.

banking.activeLenders: AIB (green products) and other commercial banks; credit unions; participating lenders under the Home Energy Upgrade Loan Scheme.
banking.loanTerms: Home Energy Upgrade Loan Scheme: EUR 5,000–75,000, government-backed, low-cost, combinable with SEAI grants.

advisory.providers: SEAI-registered One-Stop Shops (service providers); regional energy agencies (e.g. SEEA); Sustainable Energy Communities.
advisory.services: Technical advice, contractor management, grant administration, quality assurance.
